stories.title: 8 children killed in a shooting in Louisiana, police say
stories.summary: The victims ranged in age from 1 to about 14 years old, said Shreveport, La., police spokesperson Chris Bordelon. A total of 10 people were shot.

stories.title: Iran closes Strait of Hormuz again, Israel-Lebanon ceasefire tenuously holds
stories.summary: Iran's military says it has closed the Strait of Hormuz again, while a ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon is strained, but still in place.

stories.title: Tensions between President Trump and Pope Leo put American Catholics in awkward spot
stories.summary: The divide between the White House and the Vatican is widening after President Trump sharply criticized Pope Leo and the leader of the Catholic Church said he doesn't fear Trump.

stories.title: Newly approved mining in Minnesota may threaten waterways of a beloved nature preserve
stories.summary: Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness in Minnesota is filled with more than a thousand lakes and rivers. But a recent vote in congress to allow mining nearby could threaten the preserve's waterways.

stories.title: Will the DHS shutdown affect security for the World Cup?
stories.summary: The FIFA World Cup is a little over 50 days away. NPR's Rob Schmitz talks to former Department of Homeland Security official Juliette Kayyem about the security concerns people have about hosting the tournament in America in this moment.

stories.title: "Classical Music Happy Hour" podcast shows a different side of classical music
stories.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with pianist Emanuel Ax about his new podcast "Classical Music Happy Hour."
